headlineMentions.title: Closing In
headlineMentions.narrative: Alessandro Pier Guidi cut Dane Cameron's championship lead from 29 points to 3.

headlineMentions.title: Photo Finish
headlineMentions.narrative: Alessandro Pier Guidi edged Kévin Estre at the line by 0.445 seconds.

headlineMentions.title: Hard Charger
headlineMentions.narrative: Mike Conway climbed from P9 to P2, the biggest gain in class.

headlineMentions.title: Photo Finish
headlineMentions.narrative: Christian Ried edged Sarah Bovy at the line by 0.064 seconds.

headlineMentions.title: Bounce Back
headlineMentions.narrative: Harry Tincknell rebounded from P13 last round to P2 this round.

headlineMentions.title: Streak Watch
headlineMentions.narrative: Nicky Catsburg extended their podium streak to 5 rounds.
